CHARIOT OF THE GODS - scenario excerpt for import regression.

Sidebar quote (NOT scenario NPCs):
Captain Miller warned David 8 that Miss Vickers would never approve of the expedition.

During this scenario, the crew from the USCSS Montero can encounter NPCs from three different groups, all detailed below.
N O N - P L A Y E R
C H A R A C T E R S
JOHNS, OFFICER
Second Officer on the USCSS Cronus
FULL NAME: Albert Johns
AGE: 47
PERSONALITY: Submissive
PERSONAL AGENDA: Find a leader to follow and help them to save human lives.
REID, COLONIAL MARINE
Security Officer on the USCSS Cronus
FULL NAME: Valerie Reid
AGE: 34
PERSONALITY: On Edge
PERSONAL AGENDA: Terminate all threats to the Cronus crew with extreme prejudice.
FLYNN, MEDIC
Ship Medic on the USCSS Cronus
FULL NAME: Liam Flynn
AGE: 27
PERSONALITY: Fearful
PERSONAL AGENDA: Get out of this mess alive.
COOPER, SCIENTIST
Chief Scientist on the USCSS Cronus
FULL NAME: Daniel Cooper
AGE: 53
PERSONALITY: Rational
PERSONAL AGENDA: To make sure the 26 Draconis Strain does not become a threat to human civilization.
CLAYTON, COMPANY AGENT
Corporate Liaison on the USCSS Cronus
FULL NAME: Lori Clayton
AGE: 42
PERSONALITY: Ruthless
PERSONAL AGENDA: Bring both Flynn and a sample of the 26 Draconis Strain back to Weyland-Yutani.
BOLAJI, OFFICER
Captain of the Sotillo
FULL NAME: Adisa Bolaji
AGE: 30
PERSONALITY: Resolute
PERSONAL AGENDA: Turn this tricky situation into a profit without risking your ship and crew.
PIN, MERCENARY
Hired muscle on the Sotillo
FULL NAME: Pinion
AGE: 31
PERSONALITY: Steadfast
PERSONAL AGENDA: Follow and protect Bolaji, no matter what the cost or risk.
BEIN, PILOT
Pilot on the Sotillo
FULL NAME: Helen Bein
AGE: 53
PERSONALITY: Cynical
PERSONAL AGENDA: Find a drink on this goddamn ship.
HORTON, MECHANIC
Mechanic on the Sotillo
FULL NAME: Micky Horton
AGE: 12
PERSONALITY: Friendly
PERSONAL AGENDA: Help your crewmates from the Sotillo to get out alive.
AUXILIARY VEHICLES: The Cronus has only two ATVs.
